#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/.local/share/ji-host"
operation=$(printf '%s\n' "$root"/operations/install-0.1.0-stage6-failed-health-* | head -n 1)
old=$(cat "$operation/previous-target")
test -n "$old"
test -x "$old/bin/ji-host"
systemctl --user stop ji-host.service
rm -f "$root/current.recover"
ln -s "$old" "$root/current.recover"
mv -Tf "$root/current.recover" "$root/current"
rm -f "$root/run/host-locator"
systemctl --user start ji-host.service
attempts=0
while ! test -f "$root/run/host-locator"; do
  attempts=$((attempts + 1))
  test "$attempts" -lt 60
  sleep 1
done
rest=$(sed -n 's/^rest=//p' "$root/run/host-locator")
"$root/current/bin/ji-host" --health-check "http://127.0.0.1:$rest/api/v1/health/ready"
printf 'STAGE6_FINAL_HOST_RECOVERED target=%s\n' "$old"
